independent_computation.step_1_leaf_must_exist: The scenario id 'syndra_derived_order_60' pins the module's splinters option at 60 (60 is exactly the wiki's W true-damage threshold, and the splinters option is the 0-120 knob per data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json). The wiki gates the second Dark Sphere charge at 40 Splinters: 60 >= 40, so the charge is stocked and the synthetic Q2 slot (the module's second-charge slot, per data/champion-audit/batch-6.json) fires in the rotation. A Syndra rotation at 60 splinters that emits NO Q2 row contradicts the cached wiki text; therefore <absent> cannot be correct.

step_2_value_under_cast_count_reading.model: Ammo/stocked-charge renewal schedule (math-foundations 1.1) over the scenario's 60-unit window: max 2 stocked charges, one charge regenerated every rechargeRate = 7 s. Cast epochs = {0, 0 (both stocked charges), 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56}; a cast counts when it starts inside the window.
step_2_value_under_cast_count_reading.arithmetic: 2 stocked + floor(59.999/7) = 2 + 8 = 10 Dark Sphere casts in [0, 60). The engine splits the stream across the two charge slots Q and Q2 -> ceil(10/2) = 5 for Q, floor(10/2) = 5 for Q2.
step_2_value_under_cast_count_reading.note: This reproduces the observed 5 exactly when the un-hasted 7 s recharge is used, which is what the cached cooldown flag 'affectedByCdr: false' prescribes. Sensitivity: if R's Dark-Sphere-only ability haste were also applied, recharge = 7*100/(100+AH) gives 11 casts at +10 AH (Q/Q2 = 6/5, Q2 still 5), 12 at +20 AH (6/6) and 13 at +30 AH (7/6). So 5 is exact for the sourced schedule and remains the value at R rank 1; only R ranks 2-3 with the haste applied would move it, and that is a Q-side modeling question, not a defect in the Q2 leaf.

independent_computation.step_3_value_under_aoe_weight_reading: If '/rotation/aoe/<slot>' instead carries the per-slot AoE weight/target count that f3-task.md's ranking formula uses, Q2 is by construction the same spell as Q (spellEffects 'Aoe', effectRadius 210, identical damage row 90/125/160/195/230 + 70% AP), so its AoE entry must exist and must equal Q's - 5 for a full five-enemy AoE allocation. Both readings agree that the leaf must be present with a positive integer, and both land on 5.
independent_computation.step_4_ruled_out: A damage reading is impossible: Dark Sphere's minimum sourced magic damage is 90 (+70% AP) at rank 1, so no Q2 damage row can be 5. Under that reading the value would be nonsense in both the old and new baseline, but the absent->integer transition is a rotation-composition change, not a damage change, so this reading is rejected.

conclusion: The new baseline is right. At 60 Splinters of Wrath Syndra holds the second Dark Sphere charge (wiki: 40-splinter threshold, max 2), so the derived AoE rotation must contain a Q2 row; omitting it (the old <absent>) understates the rotation. The value 5 is exactly what the sourced 7-second recharge with two stocked charges yields for the second-charge slot over the scenario's 60-unit window (10 Dark Spheres total, split 5/5), and is equally the correct value under the AoE-weight reading since Q2 mirrors Q.
caveats_and_asides: The golden's internal schema for '/rotation/<mode>/<slot>' could not be inspected (scripts/ is out of scope for this oracle), so the unit of the leaf was inferred; the verdict holds under every reading that survives the sourced numbers.

ASIDE (off-leaf): Syndra R's passive is a Dark-Sphere-specific ability haste (10/20/30), while data/champions.json flags Q's cooldown 'affectedByCdr: false'. If the engine reads only that flag, Dark Sphere recasts are un-hasted and Q/Q2 cast counts are understated at R ranks 2-3 (12-13 casts instead of 10 over a 60 s window). Worth checking on the Q side; it does not change this leaf's verdict.
